paper.title_en: Prompt neutron emission in the spontaneous fission of <math><mmultiscripts><mi>Sg</mi><mprescripts/><none/><mrow><mn>258</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>260</mn></mrow></mmultiscripts></math>
paper.abstract_en: An experimental study of <math><mmultiscripts><mi>Sg</mi><mprescripts/><none/><mrow><mn>258</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>260</mn></mrow></mmultiscripts></math> produced in the complete fusion reactions <math><mrow><mmultiscripts><mi>Cr</mi><mprescripts/><none/><mrow><mn>52</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>54</mn></mrow></mmultiscripts><mo>+</mo><mmultiscripts><mi>Pb</mi><mprescripts/><none/><mn>207</mn></mmultiscripts></mrow></math> was performed using the SHELS velocity filter. The prompt neutron multiplicities in the spontaneous fission of <math><mmultiscripts><mi>Sg</mi><mprescripts/><none/><mrow><mn>258</mn><mo>,</mo><mn>260</mn></mrow></mmultiscripts></math> were measured for the first time, yielding average values of <math><mrow><mover accent="true"><mi>ν</mi><mo>¯</mo></mover><mrow><msup><mo>(</mo><mn>258</mn></msup><mtext>Sg</mtext><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>4.9</mn><mo>±</mo><mn>0.4</mn></mrow></math> and <math><mrow><mover accent="true"><mi>ν</mi><mo>¯</mo></mover><mrow><msup><mo>(</mo><mn>260</mn></msup><mtext>Sg</mtext><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>5.03</mn><mo>±</mo><mn>0.14</mn></mrow></math>. The <math><mi>α</mi></math>-decay branching ratio of <math><mmultiscripts><mi>Sg</mi><mprescripts/><none/><mn>260</mn></mmultiscripts></math> was determined to be <math><mrow><msub><mi>b</mi><mi>α</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>0.29</mn><mo>±</mo><mn>0.03</mn></mrow></math>. In addition, the half-lives were measured as <math><mrow><msub><mi>T</mi><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>/</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mrow><msup><mo>(</mo><mn>258</mn></msup><mtext>Sg</mtext><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>.</mo><msubsup><mn>2</mn><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>1.0</mn></mrow><mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>2.4</mn></mrow></msubsup><mspace width="0.28em"/><mi>ms</mi></mrow></math> [95% C.L. (confidence limit)] and <math><mrow><msub><mi>T</mi><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>/</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mrow><msup><mo>(</mo><mn>260</mn></msup><mtext>Sg</mtext><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>.</mo><msubsup><mn>0</mn><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>1.7</mn></mrow><mrow><mo>+</mo><mn>2.6</mn></mrow></msubsup><mspace width="0.28em"/><mi>ms</mi></mrow></math> (95% C.L.).
